name: chimes
description: Soft sounds for when Claude finishes, needs you, or a mod reports CI passed or failed. Quiet while you type. macOS.

done.title: Chime when Claude finishes
done.description: After a turn that took at least the time below

minTurnSeconds.title: Only for turns this long (seconds)
minTurnSeconds.description: Quick turns finish while you're watching; no chime for them

needsYou.title: Chime when Claude needs you
needsYou.description: A permission prompt, or Claude waiting for your input

notifications.title: Chime for other mods' notifications
notifications.description: operator-board's CI passed or failed, needs-reply and usage alerts, each with its own sound

quietWhileTyping.title: Quiet while you type
quietWhileTyping.description: No chime within 5 seconds of a keystroke in the prompt
